name: v2.32.1
body:
## What's Changed
* Improve methods for escaping names by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2455
* Read Vault output as UTF-8 by @pcbeingused333 in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2456
* Close backticked names that end or start with an escaped backtick by @zzoraemon043 in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2457
* Keep keepalive_ticks=0 in /dsn show --more and /dsn save --more by @goranai in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2459
* Read statements inside /*! ... */ executable comments as code by @goranai in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2462
* Upgrade `cli_helpers` dependency to v2.15.4 by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2463
* Accept delimiters containing a semicolon by @zzoraemon043 in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2460
* Strip quotes from /system arguments on Windows by @goranai in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2465
* Upgrade `pyyaml` dependency to v6.0.4 by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2466
* Keep LLM sample data text when only prompt_section_truncate is set by @goranai in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2468
* Upgrade `cli_helpers` dependency to v2.15.5 by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2469
* Prepare changelog for release v2.32.1 by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2470


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/compare/v2.32.0...v2.32.1
